Subject: OFFER OF EMPLOYMENT AND TERMS OF APPOINTMENT - SALES MANAGER

Dear Arjun,

Further to the interviews held with you on 28 May and 5 June 2026, we are pleased to offer you employment with Veloxa Retail Solutions Private Limited (the "Company") on the terms and conditions set out in this letter (the "Offer Letter"). Kindly read the terms carefully, because by signing the acceptance below you will be legally bound by all of them.

1. POSITION AND PLACE OF WORK

1.1 You will be employed as Sales Manager (Grade M2) in the Enterprise Sales Division, reporting to the Vice President - Sales.

1.2 Your date of joining shall be 1 July 2026 (the "Date of Joining"). Your principal place of work will be Bengaluru. The Company may, at its sole discretion, transfer you to any other office, branch, client site or affiliate of the Company in India or abroad, without any change in compensation.

2. COMPENSATION

2.1 Your annual Cost to Company ("CTC") will be Rs 14,40,000/- (Rupees Fourteen Lakh Forty Thousand only), the break-up of which is set out in Annexure A.

2.2 Of the CTC, a variable component of Rs 2,40,000/- per annum shall be payable on the basis of achievement of sales targets set by the Company from time to time. The Company may revise or withdraw the targets or the variable pay at its discretion and no claim shall lie for the variable pay unless you are on the rolls of the Company on the date of payment.

2.3 All payments shall be subject to deduction of tax at source under the Income-tax Act, 1961 and other statutory deductions, including contribution to the Employees' Provident Fund under the Employees' Provident Funds and Miscellaneous Provisions Act, 1952 and professional tax under the Karnataka Tax on Professions, Trades, Callings and Employments Act, 1976.

3. PROBATION

3.1 You will be on probation for a period of six (6) months from the Date of Joining, which the Company may extend by up to six (6) further months at its discretion. During probation, either party may terminate employment by giving seven (7) days' written notice, except as provided in Clause 6.

3.2 Confirmation shall be by written communication only. Continuation of service after probation shall not amount to confirmation.

4. NON-COMPETE AND NON-SOLICITATION

4.1 You agree that, during your employment and for a period of five (5) years after its cessation for any reason whatsoever (including termination by the Company without cause), you shall not, anywhere in India, directly or indirectly, whether as an employee, consultant, director, partner, proprietor, shareholder or otherwise, be engaged in, associated with or provide services to any business that is competitive with, or similar to, any business carried on by the Company or its clients.

4.2 For the same period, you shall not solicit, induce or hire any employee, consultant, customer, vendor or prospective customer of the Company, whether or not you have dealt with such person.

4.3 You acknowledge that the restrictions in this Clause 4 are reasonable and necessary to protect the legitimate business interests of the Company, and that you shall not raise any objection on the ground of restraint of trade. You will not be paid any compensation for the period of restraint.

4.4 In the event of breach of this Clause 4, the Company shall be entitled to an injunction without proof of damage, and you shall pay to the Company liquidated damages equal to your last drawn annual CTC for each year of such breach.

5. NOTICE PERIOD AND TERMINATION

5.1 After confirmation, you may resign from the Company's service only by giving six (6) months' prior written notice, and your resignation shall be effective only upon acceptance by the Company. The Company may require you to serve the entire notice period, and no part of it shall be waived or adjusted against leave.

5.2 If you fail to serve the full notice period under Clause 5.1, you shall pay to the Company a sum equal to the gross salary for the shortfall period, in addition to any amounts payable under Clause 6, and the Company may withhold your final settlement dues, relieving letter and experience certificate until such payment is made.

5.3 The Company may terminate your employment at any time, with or without cause, by giving thirty (30) days' written notice or payment of basic salary in lieu thereof.

5.4 The Company may terminate your employment forthwith without notice or payment in lieu if, in its opinion, you have committed misconduct, breached any term of this Offer Letter, failed to meet sales targets for two (2) consecutive quarters, or brought the Company into disrepute. The decision of the Company shall be final and shall not be questioned.

6. TRAINING AND RETENTION BOND

6.1 The Company shall at its cost put you through product, domain and sales training and onboarding programmes. In consideration thereof, you agree to serve the Company for a minimum period of thirty-six (36) months from the Date of Joining (the "Bond Period").

6.2 If you leave the Company, resign, or are terminated for any of the reasons in Clause 5.4, at any time before completion of the Bond Period, you shall pay to the Company Rs 3,00,000/- (Rupees Three Lakh only) as liquidated damages and not as a penalty, irrespective of the actual cost incurred by the Company on your training. This amount is payable within seven (7) days of the last working day and may be recovered from your final settlement or any other amount due to you.

6.3 The amount in Clause 6.2 shall not be reduced in proportion to the period served by you.

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY

7.1 You agree that all inventions, works of authorship, designs, software, ideas, databases, sales methods, business concepts and other work product conceived, created, developed or reduced to practice by you, solely or jointly, during the period of your employment, whether or not during working hours, whether or not using the Company's resources, and whether or not related to the business of the Company, including anything created by you in your personal time, shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company ("Work Product").

7.2 You hereby irrevocably assign to the Company all right, title and interest, including copyright under the Copyright Act, 1957, in the Work Product throughout the world and for the full term of protection, and waive all moral rights to the extent permissible by law. You shall not be entitled to any royalty or additional compensation.

7.3 You shall disclose to the Company any Work Product forthwith, and shall sign all documents required to give effect to this Clause 7 even after your employment ceases.

8. CONFIDENTIALITY

8.1 You shall keep confidential, during and after your employment without limit of time, all information relating to the Company, its customers, pricing, margins, leads, systems and processes, and shall not disclose or use it except in the performance of your duties.

8.2 You shall return all Company property, documents and data (including customer data stored on any personal device) on the last day of employment, and shall allow the Company to inspect your personal devices and email accounts for compliance.

9. WORKING HOURS AND LEAVE

9.1 Your normal working hours will be 9:30 a.m. to 6:30 p.m., Monday to Friday, but you may be required to work on Saturdays and on public holidays as the business demands, without additional compensation.

9.2 You will be entitled to eighteen (18) days of earned leave, eight (8) days of casual leave and eight (8) days of sick leave per calendar year, pro-rated for the year of joining. Leave shall accrue in accordance with the Company's Leave Policy and the Karnataka Shops and Commercial Establishments Act, 1961, as applicable.

10. OTHER EMPLOYMENT AND CONFLICT OF INTEREST

10.1 You shall devote your whole time and attention to the Company and shall not take up any other employment, consultancy, directorship, business or freelance assignment during your employment, whether paid or unpaid, without the prior written consent of the Company.

11. BACKGROUND VERIFICATION AND DOCUMENTS

11.1 This offer is conditional upon satisfactory verification of your educational qualifications, previous employment, address and criminal record. If any information furnished by you is found to be incorrect at any time, your services shall be liable to be terminated forthwith.

11.2 On the Date of Joining you shall submit originals of your educational certificates, relieving and experience letters from previous employers, PAN, Aadhaar, two passport-size photographs and a cancelled cheque. The Company shall retain your original educational certificates in its custody for the duration of the Bond Period.

12. GOVERNING LAW AND JURISDICTION

12.1 This Offer Letter shall be governed by the laws of India. Subject to Clause 12.2, the courts at Bengaluru shall have exclusive jurisdiction in respect of any dispute arising out of this Offer Letter.

12.2 Any dispute shall at the Company's option be referred to a sole arbitrator to be appointed by the Company under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996, with the seat at Bengaluru.

13. GENERAL

13.1 This Offer Letter, together with the Company's HR policies as amended from time to time, constitutes the entire understanding between you and the Company. In the event of any conflict, the Offer Letter shall prevail. The Company may amend its policies and the terms of your employment by written notice, and your continued service shall constitute acceptance of such amendment.

13.2 The Company may, at its discretion, deduct from your salary or final settlement any amount due from you to the Company under this Offer Letter, including the amounts referred to in Clause 5.2 and Clause 6.2, and you hereby give your consent to such deduction. Any notice under this Offer Letter shall be deemed served on you when sent to your email address or residential address stated above.

13.3 This offer shall stand withdrawn unless you sign and return a copy of this letter on or before 20 June 2026.

We are delighted at the prospect of you joining us and look forward to a long and mutually rewarding association.

Yours sincerely,
For VELOXA RETAIL SOLUTIONS PRIVATE LIMITED

Ms. Pooja Raghunath Hegde
Head - Human Resources
